_comment: ffmpeg -af chains that turn a clean TTS take into a stylized voice (make-voice-variants.py). Prompt-only TTS could not make a convincing robot; DSP on an approved take did, at no new API cost. {sr} is replaced by the take's sample rate. A series can add its own groups in <series>/voice-dsp-presets.json (merged per group and per variant). The user picks by ear from the labelled reel; record the pick in the character file and the scene's notes. `source` names which --in take a variant starts from (default: the first).

C.label: digital assistant: 3 detuned voices + tight flanger
C.status: picked by the user for FRONTIER ep02 (a polite chatbot android)

D.label: cheap robot speaker: bandpass + 6-bit + sample-rate crush

E.label: deep robot: down 3 semitones + ring-mod 90 Hz + metal echo
